privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.description: Perintis's privacy policy, by Rhazes Labs.
privacyPolicy.intro: Perintis ("we") is developed by Rhazes Labs. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data when you use Perintis, in line with Indonesia's Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection ("PDP Law"). By using Perintis, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

sections.heading: 1. Data Controller
sections.body: Rhazes Labs acts as the data controller for personal data collected through Perintis. Questions or requests regarding your personal data can be sent through the contact listed in the "Contact Us" section of this policy.

sections.heading: 2. Personal Data We Collect
sections.body: We collect data you provide directly, as well as data generated from your use of the service, including:
list: Account data: your email address and encrypted password when you register through Supabase Auth.

Career profile data: full name, phone number, location, LinkedIn/portfolio links, professional summary, work experience, education, skills, certifications, projects, and languages that you enter yourself.
Resume files and text: PDF/DOCX files you upload for the ATS Compatibility Check and CV Import features, plus the text extracted from those files.
Job posting data: job description text you optionally paste in for the keyword-match analysis feature.
Resumes you build: content created through the Resume Builder feature.
Technical data: IP address, device and browser type, and access logs collected automatically for security and service maintenance.

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Your Data
sections.body: We use your personal data to:
list: Provide and operate Perintis's core features, including Profile, Resume Builder, and ATS Compatibility Check.
Automatically analyze your resume (document structure, contact-info completeness, writing strength, and keyword match against a job posting) using artificial intelligence technology.
Authenticate your account and maintain the security of your login session.
Communicate with you about your account, service updates, or support requests.
Comply with applicable legal obligations.

sections.heading: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
sections.body: Processing of your personal data is based on: (a) your explicit consent when registering and using certain features (such as uploading a resume or job posting); (b) performance of the service contract between you and Rhazes Labs to provide the features you use; and (c) our legitimate interest in maintaining security and improving service quality.

sections.heading: 5. Third-Party Processing and Data Transfers
sections.body: To provide the service, we use the following third-party providers, which may process your data on servers located outside Indonesia:
list: Supabase, for account authentication and database storage (profile, resumes, analysis results).

Google Gemini API, for AI-powered features (resume content analysis, keyword extraction, job matching, and CV import). Relevant resume and/or job posting text is sent to Google for processing under Google AI's privacy policy and terms of service, and is not shared with any other party beyond that purpose.
We do not sell your personal data to any third party for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: 6. Data Storage and Security
sections.body: Your data is stored in a managed PostgreSQL database via Supabase, with encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and authentication-based access control. We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. That said, no system is completely immune to security risks.

sections.heading: 7. Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active and as needed to provide the service. You may request deletion of your data or account at any time via the contact in "Contact Us". Once a deletion request is processed, your data will be removed from our production systems, except data we are legally required to retain.

sections.heading: 8. Your Rights as a Data Subject
sections.body: Under Indonesia's PDP Law, you have the right to:
list: Obtain access to and a copy of the personal data we process about you.
Complete, update, and/or correct inaccurate personal data.
Terminate processing, delete, and/or destroy your personal data.
Withdraw consent you previously gave for processing your personal data.
Object to automated decision-making, including profiling.
Request the delay or restriction of processing of your personal data, proportionally.
Claim and receive compensation for violations in the processing of your personal data, as regulated by applicable law.
Lodge a complaint with the relevant Personal Data Protection supervisory authority.

sections.heading: 9. Cookies and Similar Technologies
sections.body: We use essential session cookies to maintain your login state via Supabase Auth. We do not use third-party advertising cookies or cross-site trackers for advertising purposes.

sections.heading: 10. Children's Privacy
sections.body: Perintis is intended for users aged 18 and above, or who have entered the workforce. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under that age. If you become aware that a child's data has been collected without valid consent, please contact us for prompt deletion.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in the service or legal requirements. Material changes will be communicated through the app or by email before taking effect. The "Last updated" date above reflects the most recent revision.

sections.heading: 12. Contact Us
sections.body: For questions, data access/deletion requests, or privacy-related complaints, please contact us at rhazesd@gmail.com.

termsOfService.description: Perintis's terms of service, by Rhazes Labs.
termsOfService.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of Perintis, a software service developed by Rhazes Labs ("we"). By accessing or using Perintis, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree to these Terms, please do not use our service.

sections.heading: 1. Description of Service
sections.body: Perintis is an AI-powered platform that helps job seekers in Indonesia build a career profile, construct a resume, and check resume compatibility against Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS). AI-powered features generate suggestions and estimated scores based on automated analysis, and do not guarantee selection outcomes, interviews, or job offers.

sections.heading: 2. User Accounts
sections.body: You must register with a valid email address to use this service. You are solely responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for all activity that occurs under your account. Notify us promptly if you suspect unauthorized access to your account.

sections.heading: 3. Acceptable Use

By uploading User Content, you grant us a limited, non-exclusive, revocable license to process that content solely to provide and improve the service for you. All rights to Perintis's software, design, and branding remain the property of Rhazes Labs.

sections.heading: 5. Use of Artificial Intelligence

AI-generated output may contain inaccuracies or misinterpretations. You are responsible for reviewing and verifying any suggestion or generated content before relying on it, including in an actual job application.

sections.heading: 6. Service Fees
sections.body: Perintis is currently provided free of charge. We reserve the right to introduce paid features in the future and will provide clear notice before any such change takes effect.

sections.heading: 7. Termination
sections.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access to the service if you violate these Terms. You may stop using the service and request deletion of your account and data at any time via the contact listed below.

sections.heading: 8. Disclaimer of Warranties
sections.body: The service is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee that using Perintis will result in a perfect ATS score, an interview invitation, or a job offer.

sections.heading: 10. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution

Any dispute arising from these Terms will first be pursued through amicable resolution; if no agreement is reached, the dispute will be settled through the competent courts in Indonesia.

atsCheck.headline: Find out if your resume can actually pass an ATS, before you hit send.
atsCheck.subhead: Most resumes never reach a human. An Applicant Tracking System (ATS) reads it first, and formatting that looks clean to your eyes can be unreadable to a parser. Perintis checks structure, contact-info completeness, writing strength, and keyword match, so you know exactly what to fix.
bullets: Instant compatibility score with a clear breakdown of what's wrong
Detects hidden formatting issues: tables, multi-column layouts, non-standard fonts, text hidden in headers/footers

faq.question: What is an ATS and why does it matter?
faq.answer: An Applicant Tracking System is software most companies use to filter resumes before a recruiter ever sees them. If it can't parse your resume's structure correctly, qualified candidates get rejected automatically, regardless of experience.

faq.question: Does Perintis store my resume?
faq.answer: Yes, so you can review past checks, but it's private to your account and never shared or sold. See our Privacy Policy for details.

faq.question: Is the job posting keyword match required?
faq.answer: No, it's optional. The structural and content checks run regardless, pasting a job posting just adds a keyword match score specific to that role.

faq.question: Do I need to fill in my Profile first?
faq.answer: Yes. Resume Builder pulls from your Profile data (work experience, education, skills, etc.), so filling that in first gives the builder something to work with.

faq.question: Will editing my Profile later change resumes I already built?
faq.answer: No. Each resume is a snapshot taken at creation time, so it stays exactly as you built it even if you update your Profile afterward.

faq.question: Is the exported PDF really ATS-safe?
faq.answer: Yes. It's rendered as a single-column layout in a standard font, with no tables, columns, or images, the format ATS parsers read most reliably.

faq.question: Will the AI make up experience I don't have?
faq.answer: No. Perintis is built on a strict no-fabrication rule: the AI only references experience, skills, and achievements already present in your Profile. If the data isn't there, it won't invent it.

faq.question: Can I edit the generated cover letter?
faq.answer: Yes. It opens directly in a rich-text editor after generating, so you can adjust wording, formatting, and structure before exporting.

faq.question: What formats can I export to?
faq.answer: Both PDF and Word (.docx), so you can match whatever format an application portal or recruiter asks for.
